page.overview:
Who is T.A.R.G.A.T.?

The Autobots stopped Destro from selling Cybertronian technology. When Prowl cornered Destro, a contingent of Annihilators and T.A.R.G.A.T.s arrived to retrieve him.

T.A.R.G.A.T.s only appear in Operation: Dragonfire and are one of its debut characters who make brief, silent appearances.
